name: com.oauth.onesdkbranch.view.forcebind.oneSDKBranchForceBindView
description: The CIB SDK OneSDK Branch opens this account-linking screen when an app requires the player to attach an email account. It sends a verification code and submits the link after the code is entered.
disableEffect: Disabling this screen prevents required account linking, so the user may be unable to continue through that sign-in flow.
